limitations: Ordinary development R2 operations use the configured remote bucket; only the E2E runner uses a local filesystem adapter.
Local migrations are hardcoded to localhost:8787 and test-secret; generic migrate and migrate:status default to production.
MCP author scope is an operation scope with a caller-selected author_id, not a single-author identity binding.
Backups omit R2 objects, AI authors and attribution, tokens and secrets; no complete restore route exists.
Repository contains CI only; current docs record Railway hosting and external host settings are not represented by an Actions deployment workflow.
